assessment: The study by Meng et al., reveals how two distinct neuropeptide signals intersect to drive histaminergic itch. They find that the neuropeptides B-type natriuretic peptide (BNP) and neuromedin B (NMB) crosstalk in the spinal cord, whereby BNP facilitates itch behaviors driven by NMB via coupling between the receptors NPRC and NMBR. These results demonstrate a mechanism underlying spinal cord itch processing.
